activity.notes: Victoriano Huerta held the presidency of Mexico from 19 February 1913 following his coup against President Francisco I. Madero until his resignation accepted by the Chamber of Deputies on 15 July 1914. This is his historical presidency, not a sovereign new polity 'Mexico under Huerta'; the existing Mexico polity is reused. His seizure of power, coercion and repression do not imply legitimate popular election or moral endorsement.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Victoriano Huerta as President
sources.citation_text: Official U.S. Library of Congress Mexican Revolution exhibition records Huerta becoming president on 19 February 1913 and submitting his resignation on 15 July 1914.
